invariants.rationale: The returned List<WriteStatus> should not be null, as a new ArrayList is created just before return.
Each input record produces at most one WriteStatus, possibly fewer if deduplication or filtering occurred.
Parallelism is typically positive for shuffle; negative or zero values would not make sense.
If deduplication is performed, combineBeforeInsert should be enabled in the config.
The partitioner is always used, so it must not be null.
